title: Fighting misinformation
thankYouMessage: Thank you so much for your support. Your donation will help keep Full Fact impartial, independent and secure. You can donate again at any time, including via Direct Debit, by visiting our website: fullfact.org/donate.
summary: The fight against misinformation has never been fiercer. AI-generated content is becoming ever more sophisticated, the US administration continues to be openly hostile to fact checking, and big internet companies have pulled their support as a result. Full Fact’s work is more important than ever before.
solution:
Full Fact fights misinformation with fact checking; covering claims made by politicians, journalists and AI chatbots. Full Fact gives millions of people access to the truth on the issues that matter to them.

But with the nature of misinformation changing, we also produce guidance on how to spot AI-generated content, as well as pushing big tech companies to take their responsibilities to users seriously.

We add to debate, we don’t restrict it. We promote more speech, not less.
problem:
The political environment is increasingly hostile to fact checking. Big tech companies have cut our funding to avoid becoming targets themselves, leading to significant income gaps for Full Fact. Alongside this, the US administration formalised its blanket denial of visas to those who work in combatting misinformation.

All this at a time when the very nature of information is shifting. AI-generated misinformation is becoming ever more sophisticated, and harder and harder for people to spot.
impactSummary:
Every gift bolsters our resilience in the face of hostility from the US administration, the decline in support from internet companies, and a negative narrative around fact checking. Donations help keep Full Fact independent, impartial, and secure. 

Donations also mean that people across the UK can continue to access the good information they need to make informed decisions on the issues that matter to them; whether that’s on their health, their finances, or how they vote.
impactReporting:
We keep detailed records of:
How many people we reach
The numbers of fact checks we publish
How many correction requests we place, and how many are acted upon.

We report on our work in our weekly newsletters to supporters, and commission polls and surveys on how the general public reacts to misinformation over time.

budgetDetails.description: to be a leading voice nationally and globally in the face of hostility towards fact checking.
to support a comprehensive assessment of the impacts of AI-generated content.
To provide resources to the public to help them spot AI-generated misinformation.
to fact check politicians and the media and stop the spread of misinformation that causes harm.

alternativeFundUse:
If the campaign target is not met we will continue to raise funds from other sources. These will be used to further the aims above. We are confident that all funds will be able to be spent to further these aims, even if specific activities are changed or adapted.

All activities are scalable, so any additional income will also be used to further these aims.
aims: We will stand up for fact checking on a local, national and global scale, whatever the political reality.

We will assess the impact of AI-generated content online. This is an emerging and continuously evolving area. It’s vital more is understood about how Large Language Models generate and disseminate misinformation.
We will provide the public with resources and advice on how to spot AI-generated misinformation.
We will continue to fact check the claims of politicians from all parties and work constructively with MPs to ensure corrections are made, and misinformation does not spread further.
